title: Sinkhorn Flow as Mirror Flow: A Continuous-Time Framework for Generalizing the Sinkhorn Algorithm
tldr_zh: Sinkhorn 的连续时间极限是测度空间 mirror flow，导出对噪声/偏差鲁棒的新变体并统一 Wasserstein mirror flow 等动力学（未读全文）
tldr_en: Casts the continuous-time limit of Sinkhorn as a mirror flow on measures, yielding noise-robust variants and unifying Wasserstein mirror flows (full text not read).
